# Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut

Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut is the Danish institute credited as the publisher of the ADHD-databasen's 2024 annual report, based at Hedeager 3, 8200 Aarhus N, with the web address www.SundK.dk[^src1]. The report's title page states directly: "Udgiver: Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut Hedeager 3 8200 Aarhus N www.SundK.dk"[^src1], and separately that "Årsrapportens analyser er udarbejdet af Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut"[^src1] — meaning the institute is responsible not only for publishing the report but for producing its underlying analyses.

The institute's involvement extends into the governance of the ADHD-databasen through its representation on the database's steering group (styregruppe). Three named individuals affiliated with Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut sit on this steering group: epidemiologist Vibe Bolvig Hyldgård, data manager Lasse Pirk, and quality consultant Mette Hedelund, according to the entity's stated significance. This places the institute alongside representatives from Denmark's five regions, professional societies, and patient organizations in overseeing the database, which — per the chunk context — documents ADHD diagnosis and treatment courses among children, adolescents, and adults across the period 1 April 2024 to 31 March 2025.

The institute's role is also defined by what falls outside its remit: the report explicitly notes that "Resultater og kommentarer i afsnittet 'Regionale kommentarer' er uden for regi af Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut"[^src2] — that is, the regional commentary sections reflect the views of individual regions rather than the institute itself. This distinction matters for readers of the annual report, since the document otherwise presents institute-authored analysis alongside region-supplied feedback on issues such as registration problems and implementation challenges with quality indicators.

Within the broader ADHD-databasen story, Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut functions as the central quality-monitoring body: the report it publishes, led by [[shelagh-powell|Shelagh Powell]] and [[simon-hjerrild|Simon Hjerrild]], covers 11 quality indicators for ADHD diagnosis and treatment in Denmark, and — for the first time — includes data from the adult population and private hospitals, alongside documented challenges in registration practice, staffing resources, and waiting times in child and adolescent psychiatry.
